assumptions: Linear elastic, small deflection, isotropic: E 487.668 MPa, a modulus across the layers (Z), and strength 18.1333 MPa everywhere (Bambu PA6-CF TDS V3.0: dry Z tensile modulus 2170 MPa x0.281 humid and strength 48 MPa x0.472 humid (Polymaker PA6-CF20 V1.1 wet / dry), each x0.8 print. The safe strength when the stress crosses the layers), though a printed part is not isotropic. Every field scales with the load. It shows where and at what load the part first reaches its strength, not how a crack grows after that. Faces clamped where held; no contact, preload or buckling. Elements touching the clamp and load patches are left out of the failure test and capped at the design stress (their spikes are artefacts of the idealised supports). Stresses are element corner peaks, as the safety factor uses; the overstressed volume counts whole elements (an upper bound). The section cut shows the surface skin, not the stress inside.
